messages:
ava: FYI I'm seeing a crash when customers load the SDK in Vercel Edge functions: TypeError: require is not defined

devin: That usually means the CJS build got resolved in an ESM-only runtime. Which export map are we publishing?

ava: current snippet from package.json:

```
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
},
"types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"
```

rachel: That shape is common, but some bundlers (and edge platform bundling steps) end up picking the require path or can't correctly prioritize the import entry. Also TS resolution can skip root "types" in some cases.

oliver: We've also seen subtle behavior differences: the CJS bundle pulls in a different fetch adapter which changes retry timing. Auth refresh tests started flaking in CI when the edge matrix ran the CJS path.

devin: Temporary unblock: import from the ESM file directly in edge apps (e.g., `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference/dist/esm'`) or add a bundler alias to force the ESM file. Not ideal DX.

ava: I'm prototyping an alternative export map that adds a `worker`/`browser` conditional target and an explicit `./types` export so TS and edge resolvers get an unambiguous path. Draft PR created (WIP).

rachel: Also recommend adding `typesVersions` mapping for older TS consumers. I'll paste a minimal snippet to the PR.

oliver: Long-term we should consider ESM-first publishing with a thin CJS bridge (CJS re-exporting the ESM runtime), rather than maintaining two divergent runtimes. That reduces the chance of packaging drift.

devin: Agreed. Also we should centralize the runtime adapter (fetch/retry/auth) so both outputs share the same logic instead of bundling separate shims. That fixed a similar issue for our Python clients.

ci-bot: Created CI matrix job `edge-smoke-miniflare` that boots a quick miniflare instance and imports the package. Queueing now.

ava: Action items recorded on the PR: 1) add worker conditional export, 2) export `./types`, 3) add `typesVersions`, 4) extract runtime adapter, 5) add miniflare smoke CI, 6) add onboarding doc note for edge.

docs-bot: Docs updated: "Edge runtimes: prefer ESM entrypoints; see SDK troubleshooting for conditional exports and bundler overrides".

ci-bot: edge-smoke-miniflare failed on esbuild@0.18 variant with a resolution fallback to CJS. Filed ticket #3102.

rachel: I'll take the types follow-up and add a `tsc --noEmit` check.

devin: I'll rework the publish pipeline so the canonical build is ESM and CJS is generated as an interoperable shim.

ava: Thanks — landing a small patch today to add the `worker` export and docs. If anyone hits additional edge-specific regressions please attach a minimal repro and tag me.
